canonical: 每列 CAST AS VARCHAR；NULL 写作 \N；\ TAB LF CR 分别转义为 \\ \t \n \r；列以 TAB 连接、行以 LF 连接、无尾随 LF；sha256 取 UTF-8 字节。

forecast_live.sql: SELECT CAST(forecast_id AS VARCHAR) AS forecast_id, CAST(as_of_date AS VARCHAR) AS as_of_date, CAST(company_id AS VARCHAR) AS company_id, CAST(ticker AS VARCHAR) AS ticker, CAST(horizon_days AS VARCHAR) AS horizon_days, CAST(model AS VARCHAR) AS model, CAST(p_beat AS VARCHAR) AS p_beat, CAST(basis AS VARCHAR) AS basis, CAST(source AS VARCHAR) AS source, CAST(submitted_by AS VARCHAR) AS submitted_by FROM dx_forecast WHERE source = 'LIVE' AND as_of_date = CAST(? AS DATE) ORDER BY forecast_id
